'''2000 DecipherCon Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (5 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 5 October 2000. [[Koen Meijssen]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1329">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-report-2000d1329/ deciphercon-report-2000], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-report-2000d1329/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 5 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Koen Meijssen]]
